profile.name: Coherent OBIS激光器
profile.description: Coherent OBIS 是一类紧凑型实验室激光光源，可提供稳定的激光输出并支持功率调节与开关控制。此类激光器常用于显微成像、荧光激发、光路搭建与其他需要稳定连续光源的实验场景。
profile.description_en: The Coherent OBIS is a compact laboratory laser source that provides stable laser output with controllable power and on/off operation. It is commonly used for microscopy, fluorescence excitation, optical alignment, and other experiments requiring a stable continuous light source.

The Coherent OBIS is a compact laboratory laser source that provides stable laser output with controllable power and on/off operation. It is commonly used for microscopy, fluorescence excitation, optical alignment, and other experiments requiring a stable continuous light source.
